messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content: Here are some fun true or false questions to help your students learn about their new 先生 today in class because they love guessing and the teacher reveals each answer to the whole クラス. Question one: has the teacher visited more than ten different countries around the entire world already 本当か? Question two: can the teacher play a musical instrument like a guitar or piano very well 楽器? Question three: is the teacher's absolute favorite food actually pizza or is it something completely different ピザ? Question four: does the teacher have a pet at home that is a fluffy little creature 猫? Question five: can the teacher speak three or more different languages fluently without any hesitation whatsoever 言語? Question six: is the teacher truly afraid of small creepy crawly things that have eight legs クモ? Question seven: has the teacher ever run a full marathon race from start to finish line マラソン? Question eight: was the teacher's very first job in a restaurant where they worked hard daily レストラン? Try them out!

8. True or False: The teacher's first job was in a restaurant. (日本語: 先生の最初の仕事はレストランだった)
